ITEM 1 | Square white plate about 26 cm across, used as the scale reference; the food sits on its left and lower half. Dark green leafy greens (mostly fresh spinach-like broad leaves with some small, deeply lobed, arugula-like sprigs) spread across the left-center of the plate, covering roughly 35% of the plate, flat and low, about 1-2 cm high, with a glossy, slightly moist sheen and a few tiny darker stems. | 45
ITEM 2 | Mixed small green sprigs with thin stems, scattered over the upper-right area of the plate, covering roughly 15% of the plate, lying flat, about 1 cm high, bright green with lighter edges and no visible dressing pooling. | 15
ITEM 3 | Single elongated piece of cooked protein about 9 cm long and 3.5 cm wide, roughly 2.5 cm thick, lying diagonally across the lower-left of the greens, covering about 8% of the plate. Pale pinkish-orange interior visible at the cut-free sides, outer surface golden-tan and crusty with a breaded or crumb coating, flecked with small dark specks of seasoning, moderately firm, dry-looking surface with no visible juices pooling. | 85
ITEM 4 | Small scattered pale crumbs and bits of the golden coating along the edge of the protein piece and on the plate surface, covering under 2% of the plate, dry, light tan, about 0.5 cm each. | 3
